_exchange_fee_note: Dollars per contract each side pays at execution, used only to state payout multiples net of fees. The exchange's FAQ words it as '$0.01 per contract, charged to each side'; the owner's published newsletter and reference code both compute 1/(price + 0.005). This follows the published convention and every multiple names the fee it used.

expected_listings._note: Listings the owner has said the exchange will carry but which it has not listed yet. Shown on the matching basin view as pending, never with a price. Delete an entry once the exchange lists it: the Hawaii landfall contract was listed on 2026-09-03 and its entry was removed then.
